property_summary: For any callee address that is not the caller itself, a successful call to forward(callee, data) implies that the callee receives a call with that data; the bug calls the caller instead, so when callee is a contract that reverts on call from anyone but itself, the reference reverts while the mutant succeeds.
change_summary: Replace callee with msg.sender so the call target becomes the caller instead of the provided address.
